notes: Every basis_ref carries its provenance tier in text: APPROVED_SOURCE for the exchange rule text, OWNER_RISK_ACCEPTED for the owner-accepted additions. basis_status only says admitted-vs-not-admitted; the tier is never inferred from it.
R9 (rounding = HALF_UP) is a property of every price-limit row, so each row names its clause instead of adding a separate rule row.

The exact document URL, fetch time and byte sha256 live in the private A-7 evidence report (#395); they are not reproduced here because this repository does not redistribute the exchange rule text (D-44 (4)).
R7 is NOT_AVAILABLE: no price-limit row starts before 1996-12-16, so a derivation before that day is rule_missing/unknown. There is no 'no limit' wildcard and the loader rejects an earlier row.
Rows are effective-dated facts, not a time series: effective_to is exclusive.

A main-board ST span before 2023-02-17 has no dated source in the frozen evidence (the SH 2020-2023 and SZ 2023-2026 inference gaps close text content, not calendar dates), so it is not encoded and derives as rule_missing. Encoding it at a guessed start date would be 'today's rule over history'.

not_available.reason: No exchange archive text exists for the 1990-1996 Shanghai band changes: the deprecated rule library (443 enumerable documents), the announcement index and the current rule library (earliest version 2006) contain no such rule or notice. Per D-44 (3), derivations before 1996-12-16 return unknown; 'no price limit' is forbidden as a fallback. Evidence: #395 comment 2026-10-26, D-44/D-59.

not_encoded.reason: The main-board first-day rule is asymmetric (effective declared price range 144%/64%, i.e. +44%/-36%) and price_limit_rules carries one band_bp with a band_side. Encoding 4400 as up_only would report the down side as unbounded. limit-v1 also keys on a previous close, which a listing day has none of. The segment stays rule_missing/unknown until the contract can express two-sided asymmetric bands and an issue price.

G-6: the original 2013-12-13 first-day notices (沪〔2013〕20号 / 深证会〔2013〕142号) were not retrieved, so this segment is an inference; it is not encoded because the asymmetric R6 rule is unrepresentable anyway.

The risk-warning 5% text is attested only at version level; the frozen evidence has no effective date for the versions before 2023-02-17 (G-3 keeps the SH 2020-12 .doc bytes but no text). Not encoded, so main-board ST derivations before 2023-02-17 are rule_missing/unknown instead of a 5% guess.

§8.1's #395 follow-up: an SH risk-warning stock whose previous close is <= 0.10 yuan uses a one-tick band instead of a percentage band. price_limit_rules has one band_bp/band_side pair and no low-price condition, so this exception is not encoded; a derived limit for such a bar is a percentage-band answer and must be read as approximate until the contract carries the condition.
